summary: Retested the full mobile flow at 375x667. App, workspace, and account creation pass; the Add expense FAB remains covered by the fixed bottom tab bar, preventing expense, ledger, spending, and sync UI verification. Backend root and valid snake_case sync pass.

ui_bugs.issue: At 375x667 the FAB is visually behind the absolute bottom tab bar. Although its text locator reports visible, tapping it does not open the expense modal.

integration_issues.flow: Add expense -> ledger -> monthly spending -> sync
integration_issues.issue: Blocked because the expense modal cannot be opened on the target mobile viewport; downstream UI flow was not claimable.

action_items: Move the FAB into a reliably tappable area above the 78px tab bar (the current ScrollView inset/margin is insufficient) and add a stable testID; then retest the complete expense-to-sync flow.
critical_code_review_comments: FinanceProvider.sync now serializes transaction fields to snake_case and the backend accepts the resulting payload.
The sync implementation still reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL rather than the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL key; standardize the environment key before production.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_iter2 transaction through POST /api/sync for contract verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use one browser session at 375x667 and clear localStorage at the start. Workspace and account creation pass. FAB still renders behind bottom tabs and does not open the modal.
rca_of_issue: The FAB remains the last child of the ScrollView while the tab bar is absolute at bottom:0. The added content padding/margins do not guarantee the FAB clears the fixed 78px tab bar on the short viewport; the screenshot shows it underneath the tabs and click is intercepted.
test_credentials: No auth flow exists; credentials file contained only its empty template.
